scope: Actual fresh GPU initialization and isolated method-level guard probes only. Not wall trajectories, solver integration, public gravity admission or physical truth. Root must read and separately authorize any build/run.

immutable_include.reuse: One main rename and one AppInfo; neutral Check/Fresh and existing project includes. No nested gravity helper include. Its old main/Run/readers are never called; no new CNG/library.

CLI: upl_gpu_gravity_init_probe_r1.exe --probe CASE -- -gpu:0 -stable [-mdbc_freeslip for wall] EXACT_RETAINED_SEED_PREFIX NEW_OUTPUT -dirdataout data -svres
single_action: Each invocation selects exactly ONE case and creates ONE fresh JSphGpuSingle-derived object. Eight independent future invocations constitute the proposed matrix; no automatic chaining or reuse of a completed solver. No execution by author.

wall.actual_counts: 1280 normal native=256 fixed+1024 fluid; opposing x-axis FreeSlip planes, z periodic
wall.purpose: Existing sealed CPU/private wall gravity initial XML/BI4 is loaded through the actual GPU initializer; no new geometry or field changes.

observer.purpose: Existing periodic gravity seed; first initialize with the currently admitted private complete-rate flags, then isolate observer-only guard on alive arrays. No CaseNpb or compound condition hack.

seeds.runtime: Both execution and casedef gravity declarations must exactly match the selected seed. Three public master/model/Ck keys remain0. Future external wrapper must bind exact XML/initial BI4/source/program/runtime; this component implements no SHA and never reads saved PART files.

fresh_lifecycle: SelectDevice/timers→actual LoadConfig→LoadCaseParticles→VisuConfig→ConfigDomain→ConfigRunMode→InitRunGpu→FreePartsInit. ConfigDomain itself executes actual wall Init (wall seed) and actual observer Init with normal production host-array lifetime. No Run/Interaction_Forces/ComputeStep/SaveData/PART restart. Nstep and TimeStep remain0; no PRE histories.

safe_recheck.device_download: After full normal initialization, independently download current actual Codeg/Idpg/Posxyg/Poszg/Velrhopg/J/theta; wall also downloads actual BoundNormalg and optional BoundSlipModeg. Verify unique normal IDs and actual native/fixed counts without changing CaseNpb/Npb or geometry.
safe_recheck.complete_host_view: RAII vectors provide full Np alive Code,Idp,AuxPos,Velrhop,PoroJ,PoroTheta simultaneously. Wall normals/slip passed to InitDynamicPoreWallGpu come from the current device download, not deleted ConfigDomain locals or stale host allocations. Actual per-particle slip is used when allocated; otherwise nullptr preserves the actual global SlipMode fallback. Original pointer addresses,Gravity,CSP.gravity,all six private flags/Ck are restored on normal and exception paths.
safe_recheck.observer_write_safety: InitPorosityObserverGpu writes host PoroJ/PoroTheta[Np] before copying/resetting device arrays; these host vectors are alive even though only device pointers are checked by its production guard. Guard rechecks may reset J/theta, so they are NOT trajectory equivalence controls. Baseline device J1/theta0 is asserted and complete downloaded device view must remain byte-identical after restoration.
safe_recheck.device_constants: Host Gravity and CSP.gravity are changed together only for the method-level call and restored. No ConstantDataUp or new GPU force is called, so this probe does not claim to test GPU force arithmetic under the perturbed gravity.

Separate fresh object. Same observer-only flags and every non-gravity prerequisite independently asserted. First actual g0 observer Init succeeds; then only gravity changes to(-8,0,0),still finite/2D,which must hit the exact observer generic gravity message.
cases.expected_message: GPU porosity observer requires fresh bounded 2-D elastic Symplectic corrected-pair fixtures without load, drainage, shifting or damping; finite in-plane gravity requires the complete dynamic-rate model.

exception_contract: Only a production JException whose full declared message and ::InitDynamicPoreWallGpu) or ::InitPorosityObserverGpu) method marker both match counts as an expected rejection. CUDA/setup/parser errors,unrelated guards,arbitrary throws and early-return Observer=false cannot pass. Every negative has actual positive prechecks in its own fresh object.

source_locations.src/source/JSphGpu.cpp: InitDynamicPoreWallGpu1616–1663:livehost read and finite/2D/tangent/exact rawdot guard; InitPorosityObserverGpu1695–1748:private prerequisites,observer-only gravity gate and host J/theta writes.
source_locations.src/source/JSphGpuSingle.cpp: ConfigDomain273 actual wall Init before host locals are deleted;375 actual observer Init;376–377 delete local normal/slip; InitRunGpu then uses current allocated host data.

outputs.probes.csv: 1/2/3 actual method recheck rows depending case; exact expected/observed method/message, intentionally NaN input rendered only in the wall_nan negative row.
outputs.host_view.csv: Current downloaded actual slots with native ID/code/position/velocity/passive density/J/theta; boundary-prefix raw normals and effective actual slip. Synthetic zeros/-1 label nonboundary normal/slip columns,not measured wall normals.
outputs.completion.json: Written only after selected case passes,host pointers/flags/gravity restored and device snapshot unchanged; no aggregate eight-case claim.
outputs.Run.out: Actual fresh initializer output,not completed solver Run.

not_proved: No wall dynamic reconstruction/force/rate/stability/trajectory/flux/hydrostatic/physical accuracy or public gravity acceptance. This does not supersede prior endpoint/witness outcomes,extend any geometry/slip/GPU public support,install executables or authorize wall runs.
